notes:
API (src/Wakeel.Design/Components/WTree.razor): WTree<TItem> with Items, ChildrenOf, KeyOf, RowOf (Func<TItem,WTreeRow> -> built-in anatomy) or Row (RenderFragment<TItem> for a custom body, with the caret/indent/handle still owned by the tree), Selected + SelectedChanged (+ OnItemSelected giving the item back), Expanded + ExpandedChanged (unbound = the tree keeps the state), DefaultExpandAll, public ExpandAll()/CollapseAll(), Search, Movable, Label, EmptyText, LevelVariantAt (depth -> WChipVariant; default Primary/Info/Success/Neutral for هيئة/دائرة/قسم/وحدة). WTreeRow (added to Enums.cs) carries Name, Icon, LevelLabel, LevelVariant, Meta, StateLabel/StateVariant/StateIcon, Badge, Attention, Dimmed — one place where a caller's type becomes a row, which is what keeps every hierarchy screen identical.

Row anatomy, right to left: fixed 20px caret gutter -> depth spacer -> icon -> name (bdi, Bidi.Wrap) -> level WChip -> optional WBadge -> flexible spacer -> state chip -> meta text -> optional drag handle. Indentation is one CSS custom property: the row carries style="--w-tree-depth: N" (unitless) and .w-tree-indent computes calc(var(--w-tree-indent) * var(--w-tree-depth)); --w-tree-indent = 16px is declared once on .w-tree. No pixel maths in markup, and because only the spacer grows, the row background/hover/selection stay full width on one grid.

Keyboard/ARIA: <ul role="tree" tabindex="0"> with aria-activedescendant, <li role="treeitem"> (aria-level, aria-selected, aria-expanded), nested <ul role="group">. Focus lives on the tree and moves by activedescendant rather than roving tabindex, because the JS folder is outside this package's allowed paths and a roving tabindex needs an interop focus call; this also makes the keyboard fully testable in bUnit. ArrowUp/Down move, ArrowLeft opens/steps in and ArrowRight closes/steps out (RTL: children sit to the left), Home/End jump, Enter/Space select. The caret button is tabindex=-1 with an Arabic tooltip and aria-label.

Search: a node survives when its name or its meta text matches (OrdinalIgnoreCase); every ancestor of a match is kept and force-opened while the search is live, without disturbing the operator's own expansion state. The matched run is wrapped in <mark class="w-tree-match">, each part still bidi-wrapped. No match at all renders «لا عنصر بهذا الاسم»; an empty tree renders «لا توجد عناصر بعد».

WTreeToolbar: title + count WBadge on the start side, «توسيع الكل» / «طي الكل» WButton Text on the end side, then WSearch with the Ctrl+F Kbd hint (BindGlobalShortcut is opt-out for a page that already binds Ctrl+F). It raises OnExpandAll/OnCollapseAll for the caller to forward to the tree instance.

Measurements: row min-height 34px, row gap 8px, caret slot 20px, indent step 16px, radius var(--w-radius), meta/state at var(--w-fs-meta), selected = --w-primary-soft + --w-primary-border + bold, attention row = --w-attention-bg + --w-warning-border, dimmed = --w-disabled, focus ring = 2px --w-primary inset on the active row. Gallery panel capped at 520px.

Host run: Wakeel.Desktop launched on port 9335 with an empty temp --data-folder and --start-url=/gallery, /json/version answered (Edg/153.0.4234.32), three CDP screenshots at 1366x768 device-scale 1 (light, collapsed, dark), log contained only "Wakeel desktop host starting up", process and its WebView2 children killed and verified gone.
